lines.text: What will you do when your usual excuse shows up?
The fix has a name: an if-then plan.
Students had to write a report about how they spent Christmas Eve.
Some also wrote down exactly when and where they'd start.
Without that plan, only about a third finished within two days.
So don't just set a goal. Say: if it's after dinner, then I open the laptop.
Give your excuse a plan that's already waiting.

post.title: The 10-Second Plan That Beats Procrastination #shorts
post.description: Don't just set a goal, plan the moment. In Gollwitzer & Brandstätter (1997), students who wrote down when and where they'd write a holiday report finished it within two days 71% of the time, versus 32% without a plan. That's an if-then plan (implementation intention). #psychology #productivity #habits
